triplet: Your ticket promises no cure.

Keep it in reach.

Cosmic PowerPoint (Broken), insight without clarity; broken chart, profound presentation.
Clown Shoe Shuffle, body becomes joke; oversized shoe, physical behavior, tripping slapstick.

Juggling Act, drop is inevitable; incompatible demands, work, love, sanity, chaos, balanced.

Trophy of Meaningless Suffering, look what I endured; pain into status, award statue and pride.

7-Day Witness, boring reveals truth; observation across time, calendar and repeating eyes.
Couple’s Swap, you can’t unhear it; another perspective, swapped positions, mirrored couple.
Family Constellation, system speaks through you; family roles hanging, mobile constellation.
Workplace Hazard, system absorbs blame; corporate water cooler, nothing is your fault.
FrizzleBob’s Guarantee, no neat endings; unresolved ambiguity, ticket stamped into the void.
The Bardo, between states; realities mix, boundaries dissolve, portal merging worlds.
The Codependent Tango, love becomes pattern; relationship into performance loop, skeletons.
The Maintenance Crew, someone cleans the mess; quietly resolving broken heart fragments.

The workers remain when the lights come on.
